description: This file defines the PHP class RequestPasswordSuccessController which manages the 'password reset success' page within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It extends the AbstractVueController and implements PublicControllerInterface, providing pre-render logic to set up the view component and template for the success message after a password reset.

classes.name: RequestPasswordSuccessController
classes.description: Controller handling the successful password reset confirmation, rendering a success message with a specific Vue component and no header template.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by setting up the Vue component for displaying the password reset success message and specifying the template to use.
